addresses.comment: **`remove_minister`: empties the minister's changeable post and drops him from the country's pool of possible ministers.** The minister comes from 0x5B13D0 (by id, by post, or a random one for `yes`). Then: find the first post p with `ministers[p->index] == m`, slot 14 true and `isChangeable (+0x50)`; if there is one, `ministers[p->index] =` the CNullMinister singleton ([VA 0x1A855C8], made on first use). **The check meant to keep a minister who also holds a fixed post is dead**: its inner loop indexes the post vector with the OUTER counter ([esp+0x14], 0x5B1246) and requires `isChangeable == 0` of a post already known to be changeable, so it never matches - unlike has_removable_minister's loop (0x5FBFE0), which uses the inner index. So the minister is **always** then unlinked from `PossibleMinisters (+0x160)` (node freed, or marked when the list's no_unlink byte +0x16C is set); a minister who holds no changeable post is only dropped from the pool and keeps his post. Nothing when the resolver answers null. No history, no rebuild. Ignores this/from. 0x5B0F40 to the `ret 8` at 0x5B13C4; the four `ret 0x4C` after it are 0x5B13D0's.

After the loop, always: `m = source->manpower * F / 1000`; recipient += m and source -= m, each floored at 0; an intel refresh of every province is requested (a -1 node on state +0xCF8). 0x5BB3A0 to two `ret 8` (0x5BBA64, 0x5BBA7E).
addresses.evidence: Addresses in this evidence are VAs. Slot 11 of the class's own first vftable, the only holder (vtable.py --holding: 1 table). Listing read whole (0x9BB3A0..0x9BBA7E). The budget exits are `cmp [esp+0x10],edi; jle 0x9bb932` and `cmp [esp+0x14],edi; jle 0x9bb932` - both to the manpower tail, not to the next unit. What slots 9/11/13 answer and what +0x300/+0x304/+0x2EC mean was not read, nor 0x5B9A30, 0x43A680, 0xE0830, 0xE06F0, 0x5BAC50 - the names in the comment are the record's prose about them.

structs.name: CIdeologyData
structs.comment: **A per-ideology table**: a country holds two by value, organisation at CCountry +0x10BC and popularity at +0x10F4, exactly 0x38 apart. +8 is the array of thousandths indexed by CIdeology +0x4C (GetValue and CalculateTotalSum, both Lua-registered, read it); +0x18 a vector of 16-byte per-ideology entries whose first dword points at an int array, slot 1 of which the setter 0x1284A0 and the `organisation`/`popularity` effects add each newly set value to. CCountry_HoldElection builds a scratch one with `operator new(0x38)`.
structs.evidence: operator_new(0x38) at 0x4FC124 followed by CIdeologyData::CIdeologyData; the two embedded copies 0x38 apart; RTTI: base CPersistent at 0, table 0x15C1C00 (VA) with 6 slots. luabind has the class with no fields, so these are not duplicates.

struct_fields.name: values
struct_fields.comment: Thousandths, one per ideology, indexed by CIdeology +0x4C. CIdeologyData::GetValue (Lua, 0x128480) is `[ecx+8][ideology->+0x4C]`; CalculateTotalSum sums it from index 1 to +0xC. CCountry +0x10C4 (organisation_by_ideology) and +0x10FC (popularity_by_ideology) are this field of the two embedded copies.
struct_fields.evidence: VAs. 0x528489 `mov eax,[ecx+8]; mov ecx,[eax+edx*4]`; 0x5284E3 `mov edx,[ecx+0xc]; sub edx,[ecx+8]`.

struct_fields.name: values_end
struct_fields.comment: End of the `values` array; CalculateTotalSum's bound.
struct_fields.evidence: VAs. 0x5284E3 `mov edx,[ecx+0xc]; sub edx,[ecx+8]; sar edx,2`.

struct_fields.name: tallies
struct_fields.comment: Begin of a vector of 16-byte per-ideology entries; each entry's first dword points at an int array. The setter 0x1284A0 adds a newly set value into its [slot]; the organisation/popularity effects inline it with slot 1 and add the new total, not the change. What reads the tallies was not found.
struct_fields.evidence: VAs. 0x5284AF `mov edi,[edx+0x18]; add eax,eax; mov eax,[edi+eax*8]; add [eax+edi*4], esi`; the effects' `add edx,edx; mov edx,[edi+edx*8]; add [edx+4],eax` over CCountry +0x10D4/+0x110C.

struct_fields.name: intel_grants
struct_fields.comment: Begin of a vector of 12-byte `{country id, duration, level}` entries: the intel pass gives each listed country at least that level on the province the unit stands in while the duration is above 0 (FINDINGS-airbattle.md). Filled by CUnit_GrantIntel, whose caller is `local_intel_boost` (level 8, SPY_MILITARY_INTEL_LOCAL_TIME_BASE).
struct_fields.evidence: VAs. 0x5D4073 `mov ecx,[eax+0x2ac]; sub ecx,[eax+0x2a8]`, /0xC, `cmp [ecx],ebx` and the writes at +4/+8.
